title: What's New in v2.9.54
notes: 📷 Screenshot & Image Upload in Bug Tracker: Members can now upload screenshots, drag & drop image files, or directly paste (Ctrl+V) screenshots from their clipboard when reporting bugs or submitting feature suggestions.
🖼️ Full-Resolution Image Lightbox: Added interactive image preview thumbnails in feedback cards and admin lists that expand into an HD lightbox modal with download support.
⚡ Instant Canvas Compression: Automatically optimizes uploaded images client-side for rapid, reliable upload speeds without database bloat.

latestChanges: v2.9.54: Added Screenshot & Image Attachment support (Upload, Drag-and-Drop, Clipboard Paste, Lightbox Viewer) to Bug Tracker
v2.9.53: Added dual-sided Season Flag fields to Season Details card and total flags summary banner to public dashboard
v2.9.52: Launched in-app Feature Request & Bug Tracker with community upvoting and interactive Admin checklist
v2.9.51: Added dual-sided flag entry fields and live flag badges to Alliance Championship matchups and archives
